title: Dynamic Sender Fields - Frontend Implementation Guide
summary: Implementation guide for dynamic 'from' and 'replyTo' email fields in campaign creation/editing forms

overview.description: This update adds dynamic sender field selection to campaigns, allowing users to choose from verified AWS SES identities, input custom from names, and specify reply-to addresses.
benefits: Professional branding with custom sender names
Flexible reply-to routing for better communication
AWS SES compliance with verified identities

new_database_fields.description: Display name for the sender (e.g., 'John Smith' or 'Acme Corp')
Email address for the sender (must be verified in AWS SES)
Email address for replies (can be different from sender)

new_api_endpoint.description: Fetches list of verified AWS SES email identities

validation.fromEmail: Must be verified in AWS SES (validated server-side)
Must be verified in AWS SES (validated server-side)

new_form_section.title: Sender Settings
new_form_section.description: Configure who the email appears to be from and where replies should go
new_form_section.position: After template selection, before recipient selection

environment_variables: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID - Required for verified identities endpoint
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY - Required for verified identities endpoint
AWS_REGION - AWS region for SES (defaults to us-east-1)

user_help_text.fromEmail: Choose the email address that will appear as the sender. This must be verified in our email system for deliverability.
user_help_text.fromName: Enter the name that will appear with the email address. This could be your name, company name, or campaign-specific identifier.
user_help_text.replyToEmail: Specify where replies should be sent. This can be different from the sender email and doesn't need to be verified.

troubleshooting.email_not_verified: If you need to send from a new email address, please contact support to have it verified in our system.
troubleshooting.deliverability_issues: Using verified sender addresses improves email deliverability and reduces spam classification.
troubleshooting.reply_routing: Set up reply-to addresses to route responses to the appropriate team or individual.
